title: New Relic License key: must be flagged
summary: Synthetic New Relic License key values built to the documented format appear in 6 inputs in CI configuration, container and orchestration configuration, HTTP headers, SDK and client configuration, structured files (JSON, YAML, TOML), and command and tool output. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Synthetic value matches the pinned lexical format contract. Provider issuance, payload/checksum validity and liveness are not claimed.
